outcome: Placental mRNA expression of lipid metabolism genes (FAT/CD36, FATP1, FATP4, FATP6, PPAR-a, LPL, FATP6, FABP7, PPAR-b, PPAR-g, IR-b, GLUT1, SNAT2, SNAT4, LAT1)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 152 lean and overweight pregnant women, with or without gestational diabetes, who were scheduled for delivery by caesarean section.
finding: Maternal overweight significantly increased placental lipid metabolism gene expression, elevated placental lipid content, enhanced placental signalling, increased cord blood insulin levels, and birth weight, mainly contributing to foetal overgrowth, while GDM played a less significant role.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, increased in maternal OW group.
